core_obligations: Part (1): LQCoh^{fbc} modules are fppf sheaves, Sheaves on Stacks, Lemma stacks-sheaves-lemma-lqc-flat-base-change-fppf-sheaf (proof lines 1159-1163).

Part (2) for the etale embedding is the delivered weak Serre argument; for the fppf embedding: kernels agree across topologies; the fppf cokernel is the fppf sheafification of the etale cokernel, which is an fppf sheaf by (1); for a short exact fppf sequence with outer two in LQCoh^{fbc}, exactness in the etale topology follows because H^1_fppf(x, F_1) = H^1_etale(x, F_1) by Sheaves on Stacks, Lemma stacks-sheaves-lemma-compare-fppf-etale and locality of cohomology (Cohomology on Sites, Lemma sites-cohomology-lemma-kill-cohomology-class-on-covering) (proof lines 1165-1205).
Part (3): pullback functoriality f^* : LQCoh^{fbc}(O_Y) -> LQCoh^{fbc}(O_X) (proof lines 1207-1211).

Part (4): for f quasi-compact quasi-separated, total and higher direct images computed in either topology agree, and R^i f_* preserves LQCoh^{fbc}, combining the delivered flat-comparison and pushforward lemmas (proof lines 1213-1218).

Parts (5), (6), (7): colimits, tensor products, and finite-presentation internal hom in LQCoh^{fbc}, agreeing with colimits in both module categories, by the delivered stability lemmas (proof lines 1220-1230).
proof_roadmap: fppf sheaf property; weak Serre with H^1 comparison; pullback; direct images; colimits, tensor, internal hom.
difficulty_reason: Seven-part summary proposition: fppf sheaf property, weak Serre in two embeddings, pullback functoriality, direct image computation and stability, colimits, tensor, internal hom; each part assembled from the preceding results with explicit etale-vs-fppf bookkeeping. H3: long capstone.
